# Ebb

> Open-source disk cleaner and AI-storage viewer for macOS, Windows and Linux. Exposes a local MCP server so AI assistants can inspect disk usage and plan (never apply) cleanups.

- [AI setup instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ege-arhan/ebb/main/docs/AI-SETUP.md): install the CLI and connect the user's assistants
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ege-arhan/ebb/main/README.md)
- [Architecture and safety model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ege-arhan/ebb/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
